entries.title: Boca Chica / Starship Flight 15
entries.dates: To be confirmed — NET November 12, 2026 (SpaceX dates often slip)
entries.location: Boca Chica, Texas — Starship Flight 15 launch
entries.stayed: Isla Blanca Park, South Padre Island — for the launch itself, as few days as possible due to cost
entries.notes:
Plan: Take Witherwings to Boca Chica for Starship Flight 15. Stay at Isla Blanca Park on South Padre Island for the launch.
Before the trip: RV oil change to be done at least 3 days before the actual launch date. DONE Oct 17, 2026 at 23,704 miles.
On the road: Dump black and gray tanks and fill water every 3rd or 4th day. Look for Twice The Ice locations spaced 3–4 days apart — we do not drink the RV water.
entries.highlights: Anticipated lunch was first listed as November 6th then November 12th and November 13th.
